newsitem.title: USA: American BioMed has cash for 12-15 mnths.
newsitem.headline: American BioMed has cash for 12-15 mnths.

text.p: American BioMEd Inc said Wednesday that the company has a positive working capital position for the first time since mid-1992, and now expects to be able to meet its cash requirements for the next 12 to 15 months.
The company said it's working capital totaled $1.6 million at March 31, the end of the first quarter.

It also said it expects to select a strategic partner before the end of the second quarter, and will see improved third and fourth quarter performance, as it focuses on marketing and distributing its FDA approved products and the successful completion of certain clinical trials.
American BioMed makes minimally invasive medical, surgical and diagnostic devices, and reported a loss of $0.05 per share on revenues of $117,346 in the first quarter, ended March 31.
